corrections.text: The article states the new VIP tier payouts ($1,000/$7,500/$20,000/$30,000+ for low/medium/high/critical) match 'the top of the old public range' across the board. That is only true for high ($20,000 = old top of $10,000-$20,000) and critical ($30,000+ = old top of $20,000-$30,000+). For low severity, the old public range topped out at $2,000, not the $1,000 VIP payout; for medium, the old public range topped out at $10,000, not the $7,500 VIP payout. The VIP tier does not match the old ceiling at every severity level.
